description: ES256 with key_use sig, on a P-256 key with use enc and a P-256 key without use, returns the key without use; decided by ADR 0054 §2.3 (purpose): key_use sig and the sig that ES256 implies agree, so U = sig and the use enc member is out; both are P-256 (§2.1), neither has alg or key_ops, and the selector has no kid; outcome hand-derived from the ADR 0054 text (conformance/tools/jwk-oracle/specs/select.json), never computed by polyjose
